info.description:
Prompt A/B testing dashboard.

Run it:
    uv run uvicorn ab_dashboard.main:app --reload

Then drive the whole thing from http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs - no frontend required:
    1. POST /prompts/sync          import the voice agent's own prompt YAMLs
    2. POST /experiments           {"variant_a_id": "...", "variant_b_id": "..."}
    3. GET  /experiments/{id}      poll until status is "completed"
    4. GET  /experiments/{id}/results   (partial results are readable while it runs)
info.title: Prompt A/B Testing Dashboard

post.description: Load the ledger (the generated AR dataset) into the workflow. Idempotent.
Run one scheduler pass now. The app also runs this on a timer.

Launch an A-vs-B run over the eval set. Returns immediately; poll for status.

The run is durable: results are saved per scenario as they finish, and if the
process restarts mid-run, the run resumes from the last stored scenario.

get.description:
Aggregate an experiment from its persisted rows.

Recomputed from stored results rather than cached at write time, so the headline
numbers can always be reconciled against the individual transcripts. Results are
stored per scenario as they finish, so this also works on a run still in progress;
check `status` before treating the numbers as final.

Drill into one scenario: both transcripts side by side, each judge score with its
rationale, the figures flagged as made up, and the head-to-head judge's reason.
Liveness: the process is up and serving. Cheap; touches nothing.
Readiness: database reachable, schema at head, scheduler alive. 503 if not.

post.description:
Import the voice agent's own prompt YAMLs.

This is what makes an experiment meaningful: the dashboard tests the exact prompts
the agent runs in production, loaded through the same validator, rather than a
re-typed copy that can silently drift.
